title: Nashua, NH — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nashua, NH: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nashua is a city in NH with a population of 91,000. Gate City with a strong tech sector, the Pheasant Lane Mall, and affordable NH living. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
